name: meta-suite
description: Nine task-agnostic meta-skills that operate one level up — emitting the reusable structure that solves a whole category of work, not a single instance. Thinking (meta-prompting), planning (meta-planning), designing (meta-design), building (meta-mvp), compounding (meta-compound), crafting (meta-craft), reviewing (meta-review), researching (meta-research), and remembering (meta-context).
